description: Fields side by side that are the parts of one value. Likely when the accessible names do not identify the parts: one label tied to the first part only, every part named like the whole, a prefix without a name beside the labelled number, one part named like the visible title, parts without any name under one text. Advisory when each part has a name of its own (labels, placeholders) and the visible title is tied to nothing. Nothing for a fieldset with named parts, two fields of their own side by side, a value and its unit that are both named, a search bar without a label, and fields in the cells of a table.
